SECT_SHAPE.description: Section Shape (SECT_SHAPE). Retrieves the list of available section shape names; the request takes no body and the optional {opt} path parameter ("short") selects the short shape-name list instead of the full list.

Argument.description: Request has no body (DTO_EMPTY). The shape list is driven entirely by the HTTP path: no path parameter returns the full shape-name list, while the {opt} value "short" returns the short shape-name list.
